title: Revert "feat(model-monitor): add favorites/star toggle and persistent filters"
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Reverts #12644 (commit 7ebfd9e), restoring `operations/model-monitor/src/App.jsx` byte-for-byte to its pre-favorites state
- Removes the per-model star toggle, the "Favorites only" filter, favorites-first sorting, and the localStorage persistence of scope/type filters
- Single file, clean inverse diff (+10 / -153); verified identical to `ada493d`
- Reopens the ask in #12579

gist.headline: Back to the plain hive
gist.blurb: The model monitor has returned to its earlier, simpler shape. Stars, saved filters, and sorting took a quiet walk back into the garden shed.
gist.summary: Reverted model-monitor PR #12644, restoring App.jsx to its pre-favorites version and removing per-model stars, the Favorites only filter, favorites-first sorting, and localStorage-persisted scope/type filters.
gist.impact: Operators get the original model-monitor view and filter behavior back, byte-for-byte aligned with commit ada493d.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli tidying a cozy model-monitor garden board: she removes little star-shaped markers and puts filter cards back into a simple labeled drawer, restoring an uncluttered CRT dashboard. Use code-plants and neatly arranged model tiles to represent the monitor returning to its earlier state.
